Clara (content): Quick brainstorm 12: tiny OSS refapp "QuickKit" idea: 1-page landing, 1-command quickstart, short benchmark story, and a 20-min demo webinar. Low friction, metric-forward.
Jasper (growth): thumbs up. Recommend gated webinar, gated replay test, and HubSpot list 'quickkit_launch'. Keep form minimal: email + deployment_interest.
Mina (devrel): I'll do the repo + README and a one-line Docker example for the landing. Snippet: ```docker run --rm -p8080:8080 redwood/quickkit:stable && curl -X POST localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Explain KV cache"}'```
Owen (design): I'll make a compact hero GIF showing run->result and two social tiles. Need two headline variants for A/B: A) "QuickKit: run inference in 60s" B) "Measure real inference perf in minutes"
Zoe (analytics): UTMs: utm_source=quickkit, utm_campaign=quickkit_q3. Track events: quickstart_run, bench_report_submit. Add hidden field original_source to dedupe replay signups.
Clara (content): Assets: blog launch (me), benchmark mini-post (Jasper+Mina), landing (Jasper), README + quickstart (Mina), slides (Mina+Clara), design (Owen).
Jasper (growth): Promotion: community org post, targeted X posts, small LinkedIn for enterprise. Route "yes" on enterprise interest to SDR queue.
notify-bot: event: 'QuickKit webinar' scheduled 2024-07-18T16:00:00Z
Clara (content): Timeline: drafts Tue, PRs Thu, staging landing Fri. Quick check Fri 10am PT. Keep social hooks metric-first (e.g., "See 2x lower tail latency with cache").
Mina (devrel): I'll open the README PR today and add a Colab link.
Owen (design): Will upload hero comps by EOD tomorrow.
Zoe (analytics): Will share tracking doc by Thu morning.
Clara (content): Great team. I'll drop the brief into the shared drive and tag owners. :raised_hands:
